implementation: Unknown PlatformException failures no longer collapse to the runtime type in auth UI. The Flutter client shows a bounded, single-line platform code/message, redacts common credential-shaped values, and does not display PlatformException.details or a stack trace.

checks.name: Auth PlatformException widget regression
checks.command: flutter test test/auth_screen_test.dart --plain-name "login explains platform errors without exposing plugin details"
checks.observation: The login error shows the plugin code and useful message, redacts a cookie-shaped value, omits PlatformException.details containing a password-shaped value, and does not show the generic PlatformException type.

checks.name: Reproduction on physical Android
checks.observation: No Samsung device or sanitized logcat trace was available; the underlying PlatformException source and successful real login remain unknown.

remaining: On the affected Samsung device, capture the sanitized PlatformException code/message and stack location from Android logcat, determine whether secure storage, notifications, or another platform channel fails, then verify sign-in and session persistence after the root cause is fixed.
